# Bread rolls (Semmeln)

Makes twelve rolls.

![Rolls on a tray](../../../attachments/f9/f91dff8490f16d946e038d39e17053b1b166a5b597fa067eb8c1a2a88debb5df.jpg)

1. Mix
2. Knead
   1. ten minutes
3. Bake at 230 °C
